title: sre-weekly-ops-sync-notes-2026-03-25-ethan-chen-draft
content:
SRE weekly ops sync + reliability review (prep notes)
Date: 2026-03-25
Owner: Ethan Chen (notes/draft)
-- Quick context / purpose
- Weekly touchpoint to review SLO health, paging trends, top incidents, and follow-ups.
- Prep notes for agenda + action items to bring into the sync.

Agenda draft:
1) Quick wins / blockers (5m)
2) SLO snapshot + error budget (10m)
3) Paging trends / oncall burden (10m)
4) Top incidents since last sync (15m)
   - brief root causes, mitigations, follow-ups
5) Runbooks / tooling gaps (10m)
6) Action items & owners (5m)

SLO snapshot (as of 2026-03-24 23:59 UTC)
- Serving availability SLO (99.9% monthly): current month running availability 99.88% -> 0.02% under target (error budget burn ~6% this week).
- Token-gen latency SLO (p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms): p50 = 110ms OK, p95 = 520ms (regression at tail).
- Embeddings API SLO (99.95%): holding at 99.97% this month.
Notes: token-gen tail increase correlates w/ larger seqlen traffic on 3/22-3/24 (spike of ~18% in long-context requests).

Paging trends / oncall load:
- Total pages last 7 days: 23 (up from 12 prev week).
  - Noise vs signal: ~40% were duplicate alerts from the same degraded host group (db shard hotswap).
- Average acknowledge time: 9m (goal < 10m)
- Top alert sources: GPU pool OOM, kv-cache eviction spikes, proxy 5xx rate (route: /v1/generate).
- Observations: paging increased primarily during region eu-west-1 maintenance window (3/23). Need better maintenance gating for canaries.

Top incidents (high/med) since last sync:
- Incident INFRA-4321 (2026-03-23) - degraded serving capacity in eu-west-1
  - Symptom: sustained queue growth, elevated 5xx on generate routes, autoscaler failed to scale due to kube-controller race.
  - Root cause (prelim): kube-controller race condition + misconfigured pod disruption budget for dedicated pools.
  - Mitigation: manual scale-up + temporary PDB relaxation; failover to secondary pool.
  - Follow-ups: (a) ticket to fix controller race and add e2e test (JIRA INFRA-4321), owner: Miguel Rivera, due 2026-04-08. (b) Review PDBs for all dedicated pools, owner: Jordan Lee, due 2026-04-01.

- Incident SRE-2198 (2026-03-20) - embedding job backpressure causing slowdowns
  - Symptom: long tail latency for embeddings; worker queue exhaustion during batch window.
  - Root cause: batch sizing heuristic failed after model shard rebalancing; one workerset consumed >80% of RPS.
  - Mitigation: throttled batch dispatcher and rerouted traffic; temporary capacity add.
  - Follow-ups: update batch-sizing heuristic and add alert when worker imbalance > 60%, owner: Samira Patel, due 2026-03-31.

Runbooks / tooling gaps:
- Runbook gaps noted for "eviction cascade" during kv-cache pressure. Need clearer steps for: identify heated keys, shard-level eviction thresholds, and controlled cache flush procedure. Owner: Ethan (draft runbook), collaborators: Samira/Jordan, due 2026-04-05.
- Observability: need p95/p99 token-gen latency per-model (currently aggregated). Action: dashboard ticket to split by model and context-length, owner: Aisha Khan, due 2026-04-02.

Open questions / discussion items:
- Should we tighten autoscaler tests in CI or add a synthetic canary for autoscaler behavior? (pros/cons)
- How aggressive should we be on PDB relaxations before rolling updates? (ops risk tradeoffs)
- Do we want to trial region-aware routing policy for long-context heavy customers to minimize tail?

Action items (current)
- Miguel Rivera: Fix kube-controller race + add e2e that simulates scale-up race (JIRA INFRA-4321). Due 2026-04-08.
- Jordan Lee: Audit PDBs for dedicated pools; recommend PDB baseline. Due 2026-04-01.
- Samira Patel: Update batch-sizing heuristic & add imbalance alert. Due 2026-03-31.
- Aisha Khan: Add per-model p95/p99 latency dashboard panels + alert. Due 2026-04-02.
- Ethan Chen: Draft kv-cache eviction runbook and share for review. Due 2026-04-05.

Prep notes for meeting (things to say)
- Call out increased paging and tie to maintenance window + replicate mitigation steps.
- Recommend short-term crisis playbook: (1) failover to secondary pool, (2) PDB relaxation guide, (3) manual scale.
- Emphasize need for better canary gating when infra changes touch autoscalers.

Notes-to-self / messy TODOs
- Pull logs for 3/22-3/24 long-context requests + correlate with p95 spikes (query: logs index="generate" context_len>1024)
- Add link to incident timeline in confluence once Miguel updates INFRA-4321.
- Remind product to give heads-up for any customer long-seq beta launches (cc: @product-hosted-api).

References / links to tickets + dashboards
- INFRA-4321 (kube-controller race)
- SRE-2198 (embeddings worker imbalance)
- Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/sre/slo-health?orgId=1
- Runbook draft: (local) /sre/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction-draft.md (will push to confluence after review)

End of notes - will tidy before meeting and attach as meeting doc.
